MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The foil tape felt like a natural next choice because my recent duct clamps suggest a job where sealing duct joints could also be useful.",
    "The heat shrink tubing complements the wire connectors I bought by helping insulate electrical repairs, and the assorted sizes make it useful across different wire sizes."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The screw and nut assortments are plausible repair supplies, but I would only choose them when I needed their particular sizes; general usefulness is not enough.",
    "The T-tap connectors serve a different connection style from my previous connectors, while the filtration housing and replacement plug require a specific matching repair that I have not indicated.",
    "The desk light and printer resin do not connect to an apparent current need, and another handtruck offers no clear benefit when I already bought one with a higher load capacity."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been treated as a broad interest in tools and supplies, even though I choose items for particular jobs.",
    "Having bought connectors or a handtruck seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more of those products without enough attention to connection style or whether I already have the need covered."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent duct clamp purchase makes supplies for completing a duct repair more relevant than unrelated equipment.",
    "Complementary supplies can be useful, but replacement parts need a clear fit, and another durable tool needs a reason beyond resembling something I already own."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly understood my practical repair needs but stretched that interest to products without a clear job, compatible fit, or additional use."
}
